audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 2 Kings / Melakhim Bet Jehu purge, Ahab sons, Ahaziah kin, Jehonadab, and Baal-temple massacre narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for letters to Jezreel/Samaria officials, killing of seventy royal sons, public head display, execution of Ahab's associates and Ahaziah's relatives, Jehonadab alliance, deceptive worship assembly, massacre of Baal worshippers, destruction of temple, Jehu's partial reform, and territorial losses.

verses.restored: Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent to Samaria, to rulers of Jezreel, elders, and guardians of Ahab, saying,

familiar.text: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children, saying,

modern.text: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying:

original.text: וּלְאַחְאָ֛ב שִׁבְעִ֥ים בָּנִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב֩ יֵה֨וּא סְפָרִ֜ים וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֶל שָׂרֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְאֶל הָאֹמְנִ֥ים אַחְאָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Now when this letter comes to you, since sons of your master are with you, and chariots, horses, fortified city, and weapons are with you,

familiar.text: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

modern.text: “When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry,

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּבֹ֨א הַסֵּ֤פֶר הַזֶּה֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִתְּכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֑ם וְאִתְּכֶם֙ הָרֶ֣כֶב וְהַסּוּסִ֔ים וְעִ֥יר מִבְצָ֖ר וְהַנָּֽשֶׁק

verses.restored: see the best and most upright of sons of your master, set him on throne of his father, and fight for house of your master.

familiar.text: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

modern.text: select the best and most worthy son of your master, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

original.text: וּרְאִיתֶ֞ם הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֖ם עַל כִּסֵּ֣א אָבִ֑יו וְהִֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עַל בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: They feared greatly and said, Look, two kings did not stand before him; how then shall we stand?

familiar.text: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

modern.text: But they were terrified and reasoned, “If two kings could not stand against him, how can we?”

original.text: וַיִּֽרְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֵּה֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לֹ֥א עָמְד֖וּ לְפָנָ֑יו וְאֵ֖יךְ נַעֲמֹ֥ד אֲנָֽחְנוּ

verses.restored: One over house, one over city, elders, and guardians sent to Jehu, saying, Your servants are we; all you say to us we will do. We will not make a man king; do what is good in your eyes.

familiar.text: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

modern.text: So the palace administrator, the overseer of the city, the elders, and the guardians sent a message to Jehu: “We are your servants, and we will do whatever you say. We will not make anyone king. Do whatever is good in your sight.”

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֲשֶׁר עַל הַבַּ֣יִת וַאֲשֶׁ֪ר עַל הָעִ֟יר וְהַזְּקֵנִים֩ וְהָאֹמְנִ֨ים אֶל יֵה֤וּא לֵאמֹר֙ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹֽא נַמְלִ֣יךְ אִ֔ישׁ הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עֲשֵֽׂה

verses.restored: He wrote to them a second letter, saying, If you are for me and listen to my voice, take heads of men, sons of your master, and come to me at Jezreel tomorrow at this time. King's sons, seventy men, were with great men of city who raised them.

familiar.text: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

modern.text: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter and said: “If you are on my side, and if you will obey me, then bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” Now the sons of the king, seventy in all, were being brought up by the leading men of the city.

original.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב אֲלֵיהֶם֩ סֵ֨פֶר שֵׁנִ֜ית לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם לִ֨י אַתֶּ֜ם וּלְקֹלִ֣י אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֗ים קְחוּ֙ אֶת רָאשֵׁי֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֹ֧אוּ אֵלַ֛י כָּעֵ֥ת מָחָ֖ר יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה וּבְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ אֶת גְּדֹלֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר מְגַדְּלִ֥ים אוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: When letter came to them, they took king's sons and slaughtered seventy men, put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him at Jezreel.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

modern.text: And when the letter arrived, they took the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י כְּבֹ֤א הַסֵּ֨פֶר֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ אֶת רָֽאשֵׁיהֶם֙ בַּדּוּדִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו יִזְרְעֶֽאלָה

verses.restored: Messenger came and told him, They have brought heads of king's sons. He said, Set them in two heaps at entrance of gate until morning.

familiar.text: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

modern.text: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, “They have brought the heads of the sons of the king.” And Jehu ordered, “Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning.”

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ וַיַּגֶּד ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שִׂ֣ימוּ אֹתָ֞ם שְׁנֵ֧י צִבֻּרִ֛ים פֶּ֥תַח הַשַּׁ֖עַר עַד הַבֹּֽקֶר

verses.restored: In morning he went out, stood, and said to all people, You are righteous. Look, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who struck all these?

familiar.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

modern.text: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood before all the people and said, “You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?

original.text: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַיֵּצֵ֣א וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל כָּל הָעָ֔ם צַדִּקִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י קָשַׁ֤רְתִּי עַל אֲדֹנִי֙ וָאֶהְרְגֵ֔הוּ וּמִ֥י הִכָּ֖ה אֶת כָּל אֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Know therefore that nothing from word of YHWH shall fall to earth, which YHWH spoke against house of Ahab; YHWH has done what he spoke by hand of Elijah his servant.

familiar.text: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

modern.text: Know, then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail, for the LORD has done what He promised through His servant Elijah.”

original.text: דְּע֣וּ אֵפ֗וֹא כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יִפֹּ֜ל מִדְּבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אַ֔רְצָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַיהוָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עַבְדּ֥וֹ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ

verses.restored: Jehu struck all remaining from house of Ahab in Jezreel, all his great men, acquaintances, and priests, until he left him no survivor.

familiar.text: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

modern.text: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his great men and close friends and priests, leaving him without a single survivor.

original.text: וַיַּ֣ךְ יֵה֗וּא אֵ֣ת כָּל הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֤ים לְבֵית אַחְאָב֙ בְּיִזְרְעֶ֔אל וְכָל גְּדֹלָ֖יו וּמְיֻדָּעָ֣יו וְכֹהֲנָ֑יו עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד

verses.restored: He rose, went, and came to Samaria. He was at Beth-eked of shepherds on way.

familiar.text: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,

modern.text: Then Jehu set out toward Samaria. At Beth-eked of the Shepherds,

original.text: וַיָּ֨קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֔א וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְר֑וֹן ה֛וּא בֵּֽית עֵ֥קֶד הָרֹעִ֖ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ

verses.restored: Jehu found brothers/relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and said, Who are you? They said, Brothers of Ahaziah are we, and we are going down for peace of sons of king and sons of queen mother.

familiar.text: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

modern.text: Jehu met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered, “and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.”

original.text: וְיֵה֗וּא מָצָא֙ אֶת אֲחֵי֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִ֣י אַתֶּ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֲחֵ֤י אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וַנֵּ֛רֶד לִשְׁל֥וֹם בְּנֵֽי הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבְנֵ֥י הַגְּבִירָֽה

verses.restored: He said, Seize them alive. They seized them alive and slaughtered them at pit of Beth-eked, forty-two men; he left no man from them.

familiar.text: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

modern.text: Then Jehu ordered, “Take them alive.” So his men took them alive, then slaughtered them at the well of Beth-eked—forty-two men. He spared none of them.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ תִּפְשׂ֣וּם חַיִּ֔ים וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂ֖וּם חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיִּשְׁחָט֞וּם אֶל בּ֣וֹר בֵּֽית עֵ֗קֶד אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא הִשְׁאִ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ מֵהֶֽם

verses.restored: He went from there and found Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. He blessed him and said, Is your heart upright as my heart is with your heart? Jehonadab said, It is. If it is, give your hand. He gave his hand and brought him up into chariot.

familiar.text: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

modern.text: When he left there, he found Jehonadab son of Rechab, who was coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him and asked, “Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours?” “It is!” Jehonadab replied. “If it is,” said Jehu, “give me your hand.” So he gave him his hand, and Jehu helped him into his chariot,

original.text: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֡ם וַיִּמְצָ֣א אֶת יְהוֹנָדָב֩ בֶּן רֵכָ֨ב לִקְרָאת֜וֹ וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הֲיֵ֧שׁ אֶת לְבָבְךָ֣ יָשָׁ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר לְבָבִי֙ עִם לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָדָ֥ב יֵ֛שׁ וָיֵ֖שׁ תְּנָ֣ה אֶת יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יָד֔וֹ וַיַּעֲלֵ֥הוּ אֵלָ֖יו אֶל הַמֶּרְכָּבָֽה

verses.restored: He said, Come with me and see my zeal for YHWH. So they made him ride in his chariot.

familiar.text: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.

modern.text: saying, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!” So he had him ride in his chariot.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְכָ֣ה אִתִּ֔י וּרְאֵ֖ה בְּקִנְאָתִ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וַיַּרְכִּ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He came to Samaria and struck all remaining to Ahab in Samaria until he destroyed him, according to word of YHWH spoken to Elijah.

familiar.text: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.

modern.text: When Jehu came to Samaria, he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there, until he had destroyed them, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah. Jehu Kills the Priests of Baal

original.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַ֠יַּךְ אֶת כָּל הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֧ים לְאַחְאָ֛ב בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עַד הִשְׁמִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל אֵלִיָּֽהוּ

verses.restored: Jehu gathered all people and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.

familiar.text: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

modern.text: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot.

original.text: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יֵהוּא֙ אֶת כָּל הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַחְאָ֕ב עָבַ֥ד אֶת הַבַּ֖עַל מְעָ֑ט יֵה֖וּא יַעַבְדֶ֥נּוּ הַרְבֵּֽה

verses.restored: Now call to me all prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let no one be missing, for a great sacrifice I have for Baal. All who are missing shall not live. But Jehu acted with deception in order to destroy servants of Baal.

familiar.text: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

modern.text: Now, therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. See that no one is missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing will not live.” But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה כָל נְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֡עַל כָּל עֹבְדָ֣יו וְכָל כֹּהֲנָיו֩ קִרְא֨וּ אֵלַ֜י אִ֣ישׁ אַל יִפָּקֵ֗ד כִּי֩ זֶ֨בַח גָּד֥וֹל לִי֙ לַבַּ֔עַל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יִפָּקֵ֖ד לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֑ה וְיֵהוּא֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בְעָקְבָּ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן הַאֲבִ֖יד אֶת עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבָּֽעַל

verses.restored: Jehu said, Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal. They proclaimed it.

familiar.text: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.

modern.text: And Jehu commanded, “Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.” So they announced it.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יֵה֗וּא קַדְּשׁ֧וּ עֲצָרָ֛ה לַבַּ֖עַל וַיִּקְרָֽאוּ

verses.restored: Jehu sent through all Israel, and all servants of Baal came; not a man remained who did not come. They entered house of Baal, and house of Baal was filled from mouth to mouth.

familiar.text: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

modern.text: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; there was not a man who failed to show. They entered the temple of Baal, and it was filled from end to end.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יֵהוּא֙ בְּכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ כָּל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֔עַל וְלֹֽא נִשְׁאַ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא בָ֑א וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א בֵית הַבַּ֖עַל פֶּ֥ה לָפֶֽה

verses.restored: He said to one over wardrobe, Bring out garments for all servants of Baal. He brought out garments for them.

familiar.text: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

modern.text: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, “Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.” So he brought out garments for them.

original.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ עַל הַמֶּלְתָּחָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֣א לְב֔וּשׁ לְכֹ֖ל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּצֵ֥א לָהֶ֖ם הַמַּלְבּֽוּשׁ

verses.restored: Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab came into house of Baal. He said to servants of Baal, Search and see lest there be here with you any from servants of YHWH, but servants of Baal alone.

familiar.text: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.

modern.text: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal, and Jehu said to the servants of Baal, “Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.”

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א יֵה֛וּא וִיהוֹנָדָ֥ב בֶּן רֵכָ֖ב בֵּ֣ית הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּ֜אמֶר לְעֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֗עַל חַפְּשׂ֤וּ וּרְאוּ֙ פֶּן יֶשׁ פֹּ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ מֵעַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִם עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבַּ֖עַל לְבַדָּֽם

verses.restored: They entered to make sacrifices and burnt offerings. Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and said, The man who lets escape any from men I bring into your hands—his soul/life for his soul/life.

familiar.text: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.

modern.text: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and warned them, “If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape, he will forfeit his life for theirs.”

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת זְבָחִ֣ים וְעֹל֑וֹת וְיֵה֞וּא שָׂם ל֤וֹ בַחוּץ֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָאִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִמָּלֵט֙ מִן הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא עַל יְדֵיכֶ֔ם נַפְשׁ֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: When he finished making burnt offering, Jehu said to runners and officers, Go in, strike them; let no man go out. They struck them by edge of sword, runners and officers threw them out, and went as far as city/inner area of house of Baal.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

modern.text: When he had finished making the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guards and officers, “Go in and kill them. Do not let anyone out.” So the guards and officers put them to the sword, threw the bodies out, and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.

original.text: וַיְהִ֞י כְּכַלֹּת֣וֹ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הָעֹלָ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יֵ֠הוּא לָרָצִ֨ים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁ֜ים בֹּ֤אוּ הַכּוּם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אַל יֵצֵ֔א וַיַּכּ֖וּם לְפִי חָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלִ֗כוּ הָֽרָצִים֙ וְהַשָּׁ֣לִשִׁ֔ים וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ עַד עִ֥יר בֵּית הַבָּֽעַל

verses.restored: They brought out pillars of house of Baal and burned them.

familiar.text: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

modern.text: They brought out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it.

original.text: וַיֹּצִ֛אוּ אֶת מַצְּב֥וֹת בֵּית הַבַּ֖עַל וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֽוּהָ

verses.restored: They tore down pillar of Baal, tore down house of Baal, and made it into latrines to this day.

familiar.text: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

modern.text: They also demolished the sacred pillar of Baal. Then they tore down the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine, which it is to this day. Jehu Repeats Jeroboam’s Sins

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבָּ֑עַל וַֽיִּתְּצוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיְשִׂמֻ֥הוּ למחראות עַד הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal from Israel.

familiar.text: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

modern.text: Thus Jehu eradicated Baal from Israel,

original.text: וַיַּשְׁמֵ֥ד יֵה֛וּא אֶת הַבַּ֖עַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Only from sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin, Jehu did not turn aside—from golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

familiar.text: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.

modern.text: but he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

original.text: רַ֠ק חֲטָאֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא סָ֥ר יֵה֖וּא מֵאַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם עֶגְלֵי֙ הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּדָֽן

verses.restored: YHWH said to Jehu, Because you did well in doing what is right in my eyes, according to all in my heart you did to house of Ahab, sons of fourth generation shall sit for you on throne of Israel.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

modern.text: Nevertheless, the LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in My sight and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart, four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל יֵה֗וּא יַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר הֱטִיבֹ֨תָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּלְבָבִ֔י עָשִׂ֖יתָ לְבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב בְּנֵ֣י רְבִעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְךָ֖ עַל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: But Jehu did not guard to walk in Torah of YHWH Divine of Israel with all his heart; he did not turn aside from sins of Jeroboam, who caused Israel to sin.

familiar.text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

modern.text: Yet Jehu was not careful to follow the instruction of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

original.text: וְיֵה֗וּא לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ר לָלֶ֛כֶת בְּתֽוֹרַת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל לְבָב֑וֹ לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵעַל֙ חַטֹּ֣אות יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: In those days YHWH began to cut off parts of Israel, and Hazael struck them in all border of Israel,

familiar.text: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;

modern.text: In those days the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael defeated the Israelites throughout their territory

original.text: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְקַצּ֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּכֵּ֥ם חֲזָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: from Jordan toward sunrise: all land of Gilead, Gadites, Reubenites, Manassites, from Aroer by wadi Arnon, Gilead, and Bashan.

familiar.text: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

modern.text: from the Jordan eastward through all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh), and from Aroer by the Arnon Valley through Gilead to Bashan. Jehoahaz Succeeds Jehu in Israel

original.text: מִן הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֚ת כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הַגָּדִ֥י וְהָרֻאובֵנִ֖י וְהַֽמְנַשִּׁ֑י מֵעֲרֹעֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן

verses.restored: Remaining acts of Jehu, all he did, and all his might, are they not written in scroll of words of days of kings of Israel?

familiar.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

modern.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehu, along with all his accomplishments and all his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

original.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֵה֛וּא וְכָל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְכָל גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Jehu lay with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son became king in his place.

familiar.text: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

modern.text: And Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו

verses.restored: Days Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria were twenty-eight years.

familiar.text: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

modern.text: So the duration of Jehu’s reign over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

original.text: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָלַ֤ךְ יֵהוּא֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶֽה שָׁנָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן

translation_notes: Jehu coerces officials and guardians into killing seventy royal sons. Their fear, complicity, and the children's dependence on elite protectors remain visible.
The severed heads are displayed at the city gate as political terror. Public spectacle does not become justice because it is linked to prophecy.
Jehu rhetorically spreads guilt—'who struck all these?'—while he designed the coercive order. Leaders remain responsible for violence they induce others to carry out.
Ahaziah's forty-two relatives are seized and slaughtered despite no narrated trial or individual wrongdoing.
Jehu's alliance with Jehonadab validates his zeal politically, but zeal is not an ethical substitute for evidence, due process, or protection of life.
The Baal assembly is created through deception, compulsory attendance, identity sorting, armed encirclement, and mass execution. It is religious persecution and massacre.
Distinctive garments become targeting markers. Religious clothing, affiliation, or attendance may never be used to identify people for harm.
The destruction and conversion of Baal's temple into latrines is humiliation of a religious community, not a modern reform model.
The narrator both credits Jehu's destruction of Ahab and criticizes his incomplete covenant loyalty, exposing the moral and theological instability of his reign.
Hazael's territorial victories show Jehu's violence did not produce secure or just peace.
safety_note: Do not use 2 Kings 10 to justify child killing, dynastic purges, severed-head displays, coercive orders, religious deception, forced registration, targeting by clothing, massacre of worshippers, destruction of sacred sites, or leader claims that zeal excuses atrocity. This chapter is a warning about reform becoming terror.
